52.authored: Source mode 2 evaluates only the incoming picked characters; exact-position selector 8 uses positions 1 through 6.
52.castleDefect: A second clear erases the picked set before source-mode-2 eligibility, and exact positions are indexed without validation.
52.chosenResult: Snapshot eligible picked identities before replacement and validate exact one-based positions without adding a new RNG path.

55.authored: Zero means any picked, 1 through 6 select one party position, and negative N means at least N picked.
55.castleDefect: All six position cases read track zero and non-position values use exact absolute-count equality.
55.chosenResult: Use one-based positions, negative at-least thresholds, and the authored failure path for unsupported positive selectors.

81.authored: Zero means the whole party, minus one means picked characters, and 1 through 6 mean one-based party positions.
81.castleDefect: Positive values are used as zero-based indexes and an empty picked set succeeds vacuously.
81.chosenResult: Use one-based positions, fail empty picked and valid unoccupied sets, and reject unsupported selectors before indexing.
